channel.title: NetBlocks
channel.description_html: The Internet's Observatory: Tracking network disruptions and shutdowns • tools and policy for change • bridging the digital divide • https://netblocks.org

posts.body_html: ⚠️ Confirmed: Metrics show that internet connectivity was cut across most of #Iraq except the north for ~2 hours this morning. The policy, in place for years, is presented as a way to stop leaking and cheating in school exams but disproportionately impacts users and businesses.
